searches.mechanism: Archive-pinned local rg search and direct declaration/body inspection
searches.query: Two-stage and multi-stage sequential ignorability, potential-outcome consistency and overlap; inspected conditional independence given generated histories and conditional laws restricted to matching prior treatment strata.
searches.result: Conditional independence and conditional-law ingredients encode each stage's assignment assumption on the appropriate history stratum, while consistency is equality along the realized path and overlap is a separate probability bound.

library_audit.gap: The assumption package needs explicit history-stratum conditioning and version choices, preserving the multi-stage lower-case overlap argument ambiguity instead of asserting an identification theorem.
